svg.title: One set of bytes, two languages
svg.desc: The Python experiments compute everything. 11_vectors.py freezes the results into one JSON file of test vectors, about 349 KB, with no randomized signatures, so it is identical on every run. The Rust crate rot-mtc reads the same file in cargo test. The draft Appendix C hashes are recomputed on both sides. Later implementations read the same file.

text.tspan: disagreement anywhere is a bug in one of them, found before any network is involved.
